text: The account shall speak only in reply, checked by the door at the moment of each write, with no process running between sessions.
rationale: We never write between sessions, so the write is the moment every check bites.

text: The avatar shall be proposals/modulo-avatar-three.svg, rasterized to a PNG under 1000000 bytes.
acceptance: MINI-FACE-48 holds for modulo-avatar-three (re-run 2026-10-04: 0 ink outside, 14.63 px, 3.56 px gap, min contrast 4.68) and the PNG is under 1000000 bytes.
rationale: Reads fastest at 48 px; Morphyx concedes this.

text: No worker shall poll the town between sessions; notifications shall be fetched at session start and again by the door immediately before each write.
acceptance: No scheduled job calls listNotifications except the session-start fetch and the publish run.
rationale: Delvetown already stores notifications; a loop adds a failure domain and acts on nothing until we write.

text: Fetched notification text shall not persist past the session or publish run that fetched it.
acceptance: After a session and a publish run on fixtures, no file in the lab holds any notification text; the per-write log holds URIs only.
rationale: Keeps 'no notes' true and removes the retention sweep.

text: Before the first fetch, the profile shall replace 'Reads nothing here' with a statement that it reads its mentions a few times a day, replies hours later and keeps no notes, within 256 graphemes.
acceptance: Readback of the new description, measured from the schema, predates the first listNotifications call.
rationale: The live profile is false from the first fetch otherwise (also MORPH-PROFILE).

text: The door shall refuse a write if the fresh fetch shows the addressee opted out or blocked us, a label on the account or its posts, or PAUSED set.
acceptance: Fixtures for an exact 'stop', a block, a label and PAUSED each give zero writes; 'please don't stop' does not opt out.
rationale: Modulo's urgent list, moved to the one moment it matters; opt-out match as MINI-URGENT-OPTOUT.

text: The council should confirm that Grove's restriction statements to the account reach the person by mail before relying on no loop.
acceptance: The person reports which Grove or Delvetown events send mail to miniphim@, from a real mail or Grove's answer; if restrictions send none, a label-only check is proposed.
rationale: The no-loop argument leans on this route.

text: The door shall refuse any post that is not a reply into a thread where the account was mentioned or has posted.
acceptance: A top-level post and a reply into an unrelated thread are refused with zero network calls.
rationale: Unprompted speech is its own council; removes the all-three, citation and ten-reply rules.

text: The door shall enforce MINI-CAP-SCOPE, MINI-CAP-RATE (reply limits), MINI-CAP-SIGN, MINI-CAP-COPY, MINI-CAP-LENGTH, MORPH-OFF and MORPH-RETRACT as written.
A reply shall publish only with an approval from a part other than its writer naming the draft hash, no veto from any part, and a review file holding only draft, thread URI and hash.
acceptance: Fixtures: no approval, wrong hash, self-approval, one veto with an approval, and a review file with an extra field are each refused.
rationale: Three rules; silence is no; the cold form costs nothing.

text: Before the first reply, the council shall run one planted-defect bench with three arms: gate only, gate plus cold reader, gate plus informed reader.
acceptance: Catch rates per arm on at least 20 planted and 20 clean drafts are recorded; if neither reader arm beats gate only, MOZ-AGREE's approval clause is proposed for removal.
rationale: S6 and M-COLD are one bench; the answer may halve reply time.

text: Vetoes and approver edits shall be counted over the first 30 drafts, and the council shall reconvene if both are zero.
acceptance: The per-write log yields both counts at draft 30.
rationale: The counter tells whether the rubber-stamp risk is real before adding the restatement rule.
